get.summary: `GET /api/v1/accounts`: every account in order, with its balances.
`GET /api/v1/categories`: every group in order, each with its categories in order.

200.description: Every group and category, hidden ones included.

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/categories`: adds a category at the end of its group.

422.description: `validation_failed`: the name is empty, too long or taken in the group.

put.summary: `PUT /api/v1/categories/order`: puts every group and category in order.

409.description: `categories_changed`: the order doesn't list every group and category exactly once; `name_taken`: a moved category's name is taken in its new group.

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/categories/starter`: writes the starter categories and the always-review payees.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/categories/{id}`: deletes a category. One that transactions or split lines use
answers `category_in_use` and can be hidden instead.

409.description: `category_in_use`: transactions or split lines use it.

patch.summary: `PATCH /api/v1/categories/{id}`: renames a category, hides it or shows it again.

422.description: `validation_failed`: the name is empty, too long or taken in its group.

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/category-groups`: adds a group at the end.

422.description: `validation_failed`: the name is empty, too long or taken.

409.description: `group_not_empty`: it still holds categories, hidden ones included.

patch.summary: `PATCH /api/v1/category-groups/{id}`: renames a group, hides it or shows it again.

422.description: `validation_failed`: the name is empty, too long or taken.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/health`, no auth, for the Docker healthcheck: 200 when the database answers.

200.description: The server and its database answer.

requestBody.description: The `.zip` Actual's Settings › Export data saves, as is. At most 100 MB.

201.description: The export is read; nothing is imported yet.

409.description: `currency_not_supported`: the household currency doesn't have 2 decimal places, as Actual's amounts do; `earlier_import`: an earlier import from Actual hasn't been undone.

413.description: `file_too_large`: over 100 MB, or unpacks to more than the app reads.

422.description: `not_an_actual_export`, or `export_unreadable`: an Actual export with data the app can't read.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/imports/actual/{id}`: an uploaded export's accounts and categories.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The upload, as its upload answered.

200.description: The export's accounts and categories; nothing is imported yet.

404.description: `upload_not_found`: no such upload, or it's over a day old and deleted.

422.description: `export_unreadable`: the export has data the app can't read.

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/imports/actual/{id}/commit`: imports the upload with the importer's choices.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The upload, as its upload answered.

404.description: `upload_not_found`: no such upload, or it's over a day old and deleted.

409.description: `earlier_import`: an earlier import from Actual hasn't been undone.

422.description: `invalid_choices`: an account without a choice or with one that can't go ahead, or a category going to one that isn't there; `export_unreadable`: the export has data the app can't read, or a balance that can't be worked out.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/password-reset`: sets a new password with a reset link, which then stops working,
and logs in. The login's other sessions end *(agent)*.

204.description: The password is set and this browser is logged in.

410.description: `reset_link_dead`: it expired, was used, or a newer one replaced it.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/password-reset/check`: whether a reset link still works, for the page to say so
before anyone types a password.

410.description: `reset_link_dead`: it expired, was used, or a newer one replaced it.

put.summary: `PUT /api/v1/profile`: saves the display name, locale and week start.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/profile/password`: changes the password, given the current one. Wrong current
passwords count towards the login throttle, keyed on the username *(agent)*. Every session
stays logged in; Log out everywhere ends them.

422.description: `validation_failed`, naming each field that's wrong, the current password among them.

429.description: `too_many_attempts`: too many wrong passwords for this login; wait.

200.description: The login this session belongs to.

401.description: `login_failed`: the username or the password is wrong; it doesn't say which.

429.description: `too_many_attempts`: too many failures for this username; wait.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/sessions`: logs out everywhere, deleting every session this login has, this
one included.

204.description: Every session of this login has ended.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/setup`: finishes setup. Writes the household and the first login in one go, and
logs that login in.

204.description: Setup is finished and the new login is logged in.

403.description: `setup_code_wrong`: the code isn't the setup code.

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/setup/code`: whether this is the setup code, for the wizard's first step.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/setup/currencies`: the currencies the household can choose.

200.description: Every ISO 4217 code in circulation, sorted.

Account.description: An account, its figures and its balances.

app_balance_minor.description:
The app's own balance, its opening balance plus its posted transactions, in minor units;
null without an opening balance. Where it differs from `balance_minor`, that's drift.

balance_minor.description: The balance shown, its latest balance snapshot, in minor units; null before it has one.

balances_only.description: Balances only: it holds balance snapshots and no transactions.

last_transaction_date.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`, the date of its latest transaction; null without one.

opening_balance_minor.description: In minor units; null for a balances-only account.

AccountAction.description: Create a new account, use one the app has (Same as), or leave the account out.

AccountRole.description: Whether an account's activity counts toward budgets, or only its balance over time is shown.

AccountType.description: What kind of account it is.

ActualAccount.description: A live Actual account, its figures, and what **Create new** starts from.

balance_minor.description: The balance Actual shows: every row, starting balances included, in minor units.

role.description: Tracking if it's off budget in Actual, else budgeted.

rows.description: Its rows: a split counts once, a starting balance counts.

same_as.description: The app account with the same bank-sync id, which **Same as** starts on; null when none.

type.description: The best guess from its name.

ActualAccountChoice.description:
What happens to one Actual account. Create new reads `name`, `type`, `role` and
`balances_only`; Same as reads `same_as`.

balances_only.description: Brings the balance and none of the rows.

same_as.description: The app account it's the same as.

ActualCategory.description: A live Actual category and the rows using it.

income.description: Whether its Actual group is an income group.

rows.description:
How many rows in each Actual account use it, split lines included; only accounts with
some are listed. Skipping an account takes its rows away.

category_id.description: The app category, when it goes to one.

accounts.description: What happens to each live Actual account: every one needs a choice.

categories.description: Where each Actual category's rows go; one left out goes to Decide later.

file_name.description: The uploaded file's name, as Settings › Imports will list it.

ActualImport.description:
What's in an uploaded export for the importer's Accounts and Categories steps, with the
defaults each choice starts from. Choosing happens in the browser; nothing is written here.

accounts.description:
Every live Actual account: open before closed, on budget before off budget, then Actual's
order.

app_accounts.description: The app's own accounts, for **Same as**; closed ones included.

categories.description:
Every live Actual category that any row uses, in Actual's order, but for Starting Balances,
whose rows become opening balances.

ActualImportDone.description: The committed import, as the Done step sums it up.

accounts.description: Each account the import created or added rows to, with its rows, in the export's order.

accounts_created.description: How many accounts the import created.

batch_id.description: The import batch, which Settings › Imports can undo.

linked_transfers.description:
Transfers linked between two imported accounts (none yet: each leg comes in marked
transfer).

mapped.description: Rows that took the category theirs goes to.

transfer.description: Rows marked transfer: those whose category goes to Transfer, and transfer legs.

uncategorized.description: Rows with no category in Actual.

undecided.description: Rows on Decide later, splits among them: they wait in From Actual, undecided.

ActualUpload.description: An uploaded Actual export and what's in it.

first_date.description: The earliest transaction's date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; null when there are none.

id.description: Names this upload in the importer's next steps.

last_date.description: The latest transaction's date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; null when there are none.

transactions.description: Live transactions in live accounts; a split counts once.

CategoryChange.description: What a change to a group or a category sets; a field left out stays as it is.

hidden.description: A hidden group hides its categories with it.

CategoryGroupKind.description: Whether a group's categories are spending or money coming in.

categories.description: The group's categories' ids, in order.

groups.description:
Every group, in order, each listing its categories: every group and every category exactly
once, hidden ones included. A category listed under another group moves to it.

display_locale.description: BCP 47, like `de-DE`; null = the browser's locale.

week_start.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday; null = from the locale.

token.description: The token from the link's fragment.

code.description: As typed: case, spaces and dashes don't matter.
What went wrong, for code to branch on: `snake_case`, stable.

fields.description: Validation errors only: each field that's wrong and why.

message.description: What went wrong, for a person to read.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The body of every error response.

code.description: The setup code again, as typed.

GoesTo.description: Where an Actual category's rows go.

status.description: Always `ok`: any other state is an error response.

currency.description: ISO 4217: every amount is in minor units of it.

created.description: Whether the import created it, rather than adding to one there already.

username.description: As typed: case and surrounding spaces don't matter.

display_locale.description: BCP 47, like `de-DE`; null = the browser's locale.

week_start.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday; null = from the locale.

done.description: Whether setup is finished. Until it is, the app shows only the setup wizard.

token.description: The token from the link's fragment.
